description: Hold stock so it cannot be sold or picked, or release a manual hold — the Inventory page's Reserve and Unreserve actions. Each line names the item, reserve or release, the quantity, and the location (optional when the item is in one location). Reserving needs that many available units; releasing needs that many reserved units. Sales orders reserve their own stock — use this for manual holds (quality hold, set-aside for a customer). Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt. Max 100 lines per call.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants. Client-pinned credentials omit this.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lines.description: Reservation lines (max 100). All lines commit together or not at all.

action.description: reserve = hold available units; release = free previously reserved units.

location.description: Location name, code, barcode or id. Optional when the item sits in exactly one location.

serials.description: Serial numbers, for serial-tracked items (one per unit).

upc.description: Item UPC/barcode, used when SKU is absent or unmatched.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

warehouseId.description: Internal warehouse id (GUID). May be omitted when the tenant has exactly one Internal warehouse.

name: reserve_stock
title: Reserve Stock
